## Statistics and machine learning

**Bayesian inference with sources of uncertainty: from confidence modelling to sparse estimation**
Rafael Mouallem Rosa, Julyan Arbel, Hien Duy Nguyen.
arXiv preprint, 2026.

This paper introduces the Sources of Uncertainty framework for Bayesian inference and develops SoU-SGL, a sparsity-inducing method with applications to linear regression, logistic regression, and Bayesian neural networks.
